A closer look

Explore the experiences.

A few favorites to help you find your starting point. Images below show our Framingham spa.

Both locations

Infrared sauna

Gentle infrared warmth for a slower moment in your day.

Benefits & considerations

Warmth & unwinding. A favorite for slowing down, easing into stillness, and enjoying a deep sense of warmth. Some people notice they feel looser and more relaxed afterward.

Make it your moment. Settle in at a comfortable pace and give yourself time to cool down between experiences.

Framingham

Salt chamber

A quiet salt-lined setting for time away from the everyday.

Benefits & considerations

Stillness & atmosphere. The salt-lined setting is a favorite for a peaceful pause. Enjoy the distinctive atmosphere, sit quietly, and make room for a few unhurried moments.

Make it your moment. Let the environment be the experience: no sequence to follow and no task to complete.

Both locations

Normatec compression

Rhythmic air compression around your legs while you recline.

Benefits & considerations

Rest for hardworking legs. The rhythmic squeeze-and-release feels like a hands-free leg massage. A popular choice after a workout or a long day on your feet, it may help legs feel less sore and more rested.

Make it your moment. Recline, relax, and let the session become a little downtime. In Framingham, pair it with guided meditation.

Before you arrive

Make your visit simple.

Can I walk in?

Yes. Framingham welcomes walk-ins and drop-ins during opening hours. In Westwood, PEX clients can walk in during flex hours: Monday–Thursday, 6 AM–6 PM, and Friday, 6 AM–4 PM. Outside those hours, Westwood visits are by private reservation.

Are the services the same at both locations?

Both offer infrared sauna, cold plunge, and Normatec compression. Framingham also offers steam, warm-water hydrotherapy, salt chamber, BioCharger, BrainTap meditation, PEMF, and Flowpresso. Westwood also offers red light therapy.

Can I arrange a private visit?

Yes. Both locations offer private reservations. hello@modernwellspa.com to plan your visit, or explore Westwood private appointments.
